YOUR INVESTIGATION

Coin gone. Point missing.

Touching the coin should do two things: remove it and add one point. A disappearing coin only proves half the action worked.

  1. Run the pickup test
  2. Follow the event timeline
  3. Apply the fix
  4. Retest both outcomes
Ready. Touch the coin, then check your score.
Event timeline & the fix

    The buggy handler hides the coin, then asks whether it is still visible before awarding the point. That check is already false. 

    // Before: the score check happens too late
coin.visible = false;
if (coin.visible) score++;
// After: record the complete pickup once
if (!collected) {
  collected = true;
  score++;
  coin.visible = false;
}

    Retesting also checks that a repeated pickup cannot award another point.

    The replay runs the same movement and pickup code as manual play. This browser simulation demonstrates event ordering and outcome assertions.
